title: You've Never Seen Your Own Eyes Move
takeaway: Your eyes jump about three times a second, and during each jump your brain switches the picture off (saccadic masking), so you can never see your own eyes move in a mirror. The brain also edits your always-visible nose out of what you see.
lines: see lines.json (captions) and tts.json (text with audio tags sent to ElevenLabs)
hooks_considered: You have never seen your own eyes move. Not even once. (kept)
You're blind for about 40 minutes a day. (rejected: daily total only weakly sourced)
Look in a mirror: your eyes never move.
Your nose is in every picture your eyes take.
Your brain switches your eyes off 3 times a second.
sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saccadic_masking (vision suppressed during saccades; looking from one eye to the other in a mirror, the eyes can never be observed in motion)
https://oreilly.com/library/view/mind-hacks/0596007795/ch02s05.html (Mind Hacks #17: up to five saccades a second; you can't see your own eyes moving)
https://aplab.bcs.rochester.edu/assets/download/PDFs/articles/RucciPoletti15.pdf (Rucci & Poletti 2015: humans make about three saccades per second)
https://www.livescience.com/health/why-dont-you-usually-see-your-nose (the brain filters out the nose that is always in view)
pacing_brief: Hook = Kalu's flat true claim over Battery's big mirror reflection in the first second, cut to Kalu close on 'Not even once'. 37.7 s, 9 lines, ~20 shots, cut on every line. Mirror insert where Battery's pupils SNAP left/right with no in-between frames (the 'teleport' joke shows the science). 3-step science insert: gaze ring hops sun/tree/house 3x a second, a cute brain flips a light switch so the picture blacks out on each hop, a smeared blurry picture snaps back to crisp. Battery blinks 3x a second in horror. Film strip with black gaps painted over by the brain. POV insert: Battery's own nose at the bottom of his view, the brain erases it; it comes back when he notices it. Viewer-participation ending: Kalu turns to camera, 'So can everyone watching this' (loops to the claim). Owner fast mix: atempo 1.08-1.1, caps .14-.24, gaps .08-.3 s.
